# Bart

BART (Bay Area Rapid Transit) provides public transportation services in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bart/.

## Actions

- **Download GTFS Static Schedule Feed**: Download the static gtfs feed (google transit.zip).
- **Get BART Available Schedules**: Retrieve a list of currently released bart schedules.
- **Get BART Schedule Arrive** (read-only): Retrieve schedule information based on a specified arrival time.
- **Get BART Schedule Depart**: Get schedule information based on a specified depart time.
- **Get GTFS-RT Trip Updates**: Fetch real-time trip updates in gtfs-realtime format.
- **Get Route Info**: Fetch detailed information about a specific bart route.
- **Get Service Advisories** (read-only): Fetch current bart service advisories.
- **Get Station Info** (read-only): Fetch detailed information for a specified bart station.
- **Get BART API Version**: Stub action for bart api version retrieval.
- **Get BART Stations**: Stub action for bart stations retrieval.
